meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 可以用 OpenAI 的 Codex 作为完整代理后端，负责规划、调用工具、管理会话历史和恢复对话，代替或补充 Claude 自身的规划能力。
howto.when: 当你为某个群组运行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 命令后，该群组的对话就会交由 Codex 处理。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can use OpenAI's Codex as a full agent backend for planning, tool orchestration, server-side conversation history, and session resume, either alongside or instead of Claude's native planning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run `ncl groups config update --provider codex` for a specific group, switching that group's agent backend to Codex.

say_en.text: Switch group A's provider to Codex.
say_en.note: Group A will use Codex as agent.

say_en.text: Check if Codex is installed and authenticated.
Set Codex as default for new groups.
